spectators.name: Kenshiro
spectators.look: towering heavily muscled martial artist with short black hair, thick brows and a stern stoic face; dark blue-black sleeveless leather jacket with big padded shoulders hanging open over a bare chest marked with seven red scars in a Big Dipper pattern, wide brown belt, black pants, black boots, white wrist wraps
spectators.fallbackLook: towering stoic muscular man with short black hair, an open dark sleeveless leather jacket with large padded shoulders, seven red scars in a dipper-constellation pattern on his bare chest, wide brown belt, black pants and boots
spectators.idle: arms crossed, stoic unblinking stare at the ring
spectators.cheer: one fist pushed out to the side, cracking his knuckles with a faint smile
spectators.shocked: rare startled look, eyes wide, both fists clenched at his sides

spectators.name: Raoh
spectators.look: giant muscular warlord with long wild dark-brown hair and a fierce scowl; black armor with gold trim, huge spiked shoulder plates, a black helmet with a gold crest, thick black gauntlets and a long black cape with red lining
spectators.fallbackLook: giant muscular warlord with long wild dark hair and a fierce scowl, black armor trimmed in gold with huge spiked shoulder plates, a gold-crested helmet, thick gauntlets and a long black red-lined cape
spectators.idle: arms folded, chin raised in arrogant judgment
spectators.cheer: both arms spread wide to the sides, roaring, cape flaring
spectators.shocked: leaning back, gritting his teeth, one gauntlet raised

spectators.name: Toki
spectators.look: tall lean gentle man with long flowing silver-white hair, a pale serene face and calm half-closed eyes; loose grey-white hooded robe wrapped over a dark grey tunic, simple cloth belt, cloth shoes
spectators.fallbackLook: tall lean gentle man with long flowing silver-white hair, a pale serene face and calm half-closed eyes, wearing a loose grey-white hooded robe over a dark grey tunic with a simple cloth belt
spectators.idle: hands tucked in his sleeves, serene smile
spectators.cheer: one open palm raised beside his head, smiling warmly
spectators.shocked: hand over his mouth, coughing in surprise, eyes open wide

spectators.name: Rei
spectators.look: lean handsome martial artist with very long straight dark-blue hair, sharp narrow eyes and a confident smirk; light-blue sleeveless high-collar martial top, wide white sash, dark-blue pants, white cloth wraps on both forearms
spectators.fallbackLook: lean handsome man with very long straight dark-blue hair and sharp narrow eyes, light-blue sleeveless high-collar martial top, wide white sash, dark-blue pants and white forearm wraps
spectators.idle: hand on hip, flicking his long hair back
spectators.cheer: fingers held stiff like blades, slashing the air sideways with a shout
spectators.shocked: hair whipping across his face, eyes wide

spectators.name: Jagi
spectators.look: hulking punk villain in a battered steel helmet with a narrow visor slit over a swollen scarred face; studded black leather vest with spiked shoulder pads, seven crude scars on his bare chest, ripped black pants, heavy boots, sawed-off shotgun in one hand
spectators.fallbackLook: hulking punk thug in a battered steel helmet with a visor slit over a swollen scarred face, studded black leather vest with spiked shoulder pads, crude scars on his bare chest, ripped black pants and a sawed-off shotgun
spectators.idle: shotgun resting on his shoulder, sneering
spectators.cheer: shotgun waved sideways, shouting with menace
spectators.shocked: helmet knocked crooked, recoiling with a snarl

spectators.name: Lin
spectators.look: small brave girl with short chestnut-brown bob hair and big hopeful eyes; simple pale-pink short-sleeve dress with a white collar, brown sandals, a small yellow wildflower in her hands
spectators.fallbackLook: small brave girl with short chestnut-brown bob hair and big hopeful eyes, simple pale-pink short-sleeve dress with a white collar, brown sandals, holding a small yellow wildflower
spectators.idle: hugging a little flower, watching hopefully
spectators.cheer: jumping with both hands up, cheering
spectators.shocked: hands over her eyes, peeking between her fingers

spectators.name: Bat
spectators.look: scrappy street-kid boy with messy spiky brown hair, a cocky grin and a smudged nose; oversized brown leather vest over a torn mustard-yellow shirt, red scarf around his neck, patched grey pants, a coil of rope on his belt
spectators.fallbackLook: scrappy street-kid boy with messy spiky brown hair, a cocky grin and a smudged nose, oversized brown leather vest over a torn mustard-yellow shirt, red neck scarf, patched grey pants and a rope coil on his belt
spectators.idle: hands behind his head, cocky grin
spectators.cheer: waving his red scarf overhead, yelling
spectators.shocked: jumping back, hair standing on end

spectators.name: Mohawk Raider (wasteland thug)
spectators.look: hulking wasteland raider with a towering acid-green mohawk, shaved sides and a gap-toothed grin; spiked black leather shoulder pads, studded leather harness over a bare chest, torn camo pants, combat boots, a heavy chain wrapped around one fist
spectators.fallbackLook: hulking post-apocalyptic raider with a towering acid-green mohawk and shaved sides, gap-toothed grin, spiked black leather shoulder pads, studded harness over a bare chest, torn camo pants and a chain wrapped around one fist
spectators.idle: licking his lips, swinging the chain lazily
spectators.cheer: both arms flung wide to the sides, howling
spectators.shocked: mohawk drooping, mouth gaping, chain dropped
